results.title: 30-year sentence imposed for fatal shooting of a man in a tent in Bonner
results.description: The defendant had argued the victim was strangling his girlfriend at the time of the fatal shooting, but a jury found him guilty of mitigated deliberate homicide in August.

results.title: Local races to be decided on Nov. 3
results.description: As of Oct. 23, Teton County had 4,326 registered voters (including active and inactive) who could take part in the Nov. 3 general election, according to Teton County Election Administrator Sarah Clarke.
